title: Boat, Kayak & Sailboat Financing
seo_title: Boat, Kayak & Sailboat Financing | Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Affordable financing for boats, motors, trailers, kayaks, lifts and service work from Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL. Terms up to 20 years. Contact us today.
body_html:
Quest specializes in providing affordable financing for boats, lifts, kayaks and even mechanical services. We have partnered with the industry's finest lending institutions to provide you with the ultimate in flexibility.

Boats, Sailboats, Motors and Trailers

Financing options for titled vessels, motors and trailers (including sailboats) often include:

  • Terms up to 20 years
  • Deferred monthly payments
  • Approvals for "less-than-perfect" credit history

In addition, we offer cost-effective extended warranty plans to provide you with maximum peace of mind.

Kayaks, Boat Lifts and Services

Through partnerships with Synchrony and OneMain, Quest can help you obtain up to 100% financing for non-titled items, such as:

  • Kayaks, paddleboards and accessories
  • Boat lifts and installation
  • Services including mechanical repairs and equipment upgrades

No need to wait for that new kayak or boat improvement project you have been thinking about.

Get Started

Email finance@questwatersports.com or call 815.433.2200. Browse boats, kayaks and paddleboards or sailboats.
